story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price RELIANCE to move about ±5.6%, roughly 1,309 to 1,464. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 59% of the time.
RELIANCE futures trade 4.0 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 3.3% a year, lower than almost any day this past year: hedgers or short sellers are leaning on the futures.
Options are cheap compared with how much RELIANCE has actually been moving: they price 23.9% a year while the last month realised 39.2%.
RELIANCE has actually been moving about 2.47% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.

Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 67% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Near and far options on RELIANCE are priced about the same: nothing special is expected soon.

skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -2.50 vol pts (front month), 13th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 1,400 (+1.3% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 1,350 (-2.4%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.63; all-expiry OI PCR at the 65th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +4,372,500, puts +570,000 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.analyst: Near-month basis +4.0, annualised carry 3.3% (7th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.4%).
